campaign.name: SLO four-week launch research plan
campaign.goal: Validate qualified demand and trust messaging

audience.name: Ableton-first sample producers
audience.job_to_be_done: Find useful samples quickly without losing trust in tags or musical context

evidence.text: Live exposes tag search and sound similarity search as core browser workflows.

insights.text: SLO's current benchmark is single-vendor and has known filename ambiguity.
Search trust is likely a stronger launch message than generic AI classification.
Show before/after retrieval examples using legally cleared fixtures.
A short browser demo comparing ambiguous names could be a compelling creative asset.

experiments.name: retrieval-proof
experiments.hypothesis: A concrete search task outperforms abstract AI claims.

experiments.name: vendor-honesty
experiments.hypothesis: Explicitly stating supported corpus limits increases trust.
experiments.guardrail: do not imply multi-vendor accuracy before validation
